verdict.rationale: Vestd lists 'Share certificates' as a feature (title only, no description). It also documents digital share issuance with 'no paperwork', in-platform deed/witness signatures, and a reconciled digital cap table, so electronic certificates produced alongside issuance are plausible but not described in detail. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that certificates are generated electronically and legally signed in-platform, evidence that each certificate is permanently linked to its cap table entry, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
